snippet.title: Papaya Plaza - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🥭Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4580030/Papaya_Plaza/

Papaya Plaza is a snackable slice of life game for you to get lost in. Decorate and improve the town as you see fit, to make a perfect little spot for visitors to wander and enjoy.  These beeps aren't picky, they just want to discover the next best-kept-secret!

🍉Follow us on socials: https://linktr.ee/biscuitfactorygames
